anomalies.description: Two boys engage in mutual physical combat: one in a striped shirt raises his arms while the other in a black shirt with 'NASCO' and number '9' strikes or grapples with him; a third child watches closely.; The fight continues with increased intensity: the boy in the striped shirt is visibly struck or pushed, raising both arms defensively, while the other boy maintains aggressive posture; an adult woman intervenes from behind.

A boy in a black shirt (number '9') appears to strike or forcefully push the boy in the striped shirt, who is recoiling and raising hands; the interaction suggests one-sided aggression during a brief lull in mutual combat.
The two boys re-engage in mutual physical struggle: the boy in the striped shirt grabs or pushes the other, who retaliates; a woman in the background actively intervenes by reaching toward them.
A person is seen cutting the neck of a live chicken with a knife, causing visible distress and injury to the animal.
A chicken is being violently flung or thrown into a large pot or container, suggesting forceful handling and potential harm.
A chicken is shown in mid-air, seemingly thrown or dropped from a height onto a rooftop or structure, indicating reckless or harmful treatment.
A person in a striped shirt is seen holding a handgun and pointing it forward; motion blur suggests rapid movement consistent with firing or preparing to fire.

Two individuals engage in a physical fight in a narrow alley; one person in a light shirt appears to strike or grapple with another person holding a motorcycle, while a child runs away in the background.
A person in the foreground points a handgun directly at the camera; other individuals behind appear to be holding weapons and reacting, consistent with an active shooting event.
Sudden intense white flash and overexposure across the frame, obscuring all detail, consistent with a nearby explosion or muzzle flash from a firearm discharge.

A large group of young people, many holding firearms, gather in a street and collectively raise their weapons while shouting; this constitutes collective violent unrest with clear intent to intimidate or threaten, meeting the definition of riot.

In frames f6–f8, multiple individuals are aiming handguns directly forward; one individual (center-left in f7) appears to have just fired or is in the act of firing, with visible muzzle flash or recoil motion and barrel alignment consistent with discharge. However, no definitive smoke, flash, or bullet impact is unambiguously visible due to image blur and resolution, so confidence is moderate.
A group of armed individuals, including one holding a pistol to another’s head, confront each other in a street; multiple guns are drawn and pointed, indicating violent group unrest.
A man in a pink shirt fires a long gun (likely a shotgun or rifle) from behind wooden pallets; muzzle flash and smoke are visible at the barrel during frames f8–f11.

A large group of people (15+ individuals) engage in chaotic, aggressive physical movement in the street, including grappling, shoving, and running toward/away from each other; consistent with collective violent unrest.
At least two pairs of individuals are engaged in mutual physical combat in the street: one pair grappling centrally (f3–f5), another pair wrestling near the right edge (f4–f5).

The same man in the pink shirt reappears at the same location, raising and aiming the firearm again; posture and weapon orientation indicate active shooting stance, though no muzzle flash is visible in these frames due to lighting or angle.
